name: AABB Face Normal Test
definition: A simplified intersection test for AABBs aligned with the coordinate axes, performed by translating the AABB center to the origin and comparing the triangle's vertex extents against the AABB's half-extents.
summary: The AABB Face Normal Test is a fast, simplified intersection check that detects separation between a triangle and an axis-aligned box by comparing vertex extents against half-extents along the three coordinate axes.
